_readme: Staged website features. Each one is already built and tested; true turns it on, false hides it completely. Change these here and run node build.js, or use the 'Turn a website feature on or off' workflow on GitHub Actions, which does both and publishes.
_towInterestCheck: Layer 1. The 'Can't drive it over?' tap-to-tell-us block on the estimate and collision pages. Collects anonymous counts only, asks for nothing, promises nothing.
_towRequestPage: Layer 2. The full /tow-and-loaner page, linked from the nav, with a request form. Turn this on once layer 1 shows people want it.
_requestFormUrl: Google Form link used by the layer 2 page. While it is empty the page asks people to call or book instead.
_reviewUrl: Google review link for the /review page that gets texted to customers after pickup and printed on the counter card. While it is empty there is no review page at all, so the link can never go out dead. Paste the short link from the Google Business Profile 'Ask for reviews' button.
_giftCardUrl: Clover's hosted gift card page. Set this and the /gift-cards page is built and linked from the menu; leave it empty and the page does not exist at all. Get the link from the Clover Dashboard under Settings > Business Operations > Sell Digital Gift Cards Online.
_handoffFolderUrl: Shared Drive folder where loaner handoff photos and documents go. Shown as a button on the staff handoff page.
